IN2-SaaS Recruitment are representing one of Europe’s fastest-growing FinTech SaaS providers. This client has recently secured Series C investment and is scaling operations across EMEA. Their platform is trusted by some of the largest global banks and insurers to modernise payments, compliance, and customer onboarding. With a headcount of 500+ and ambitious plans to double in the next two years, they are now seeking a senior sales leader to accelerate enterprise growth.

The Role:

This is a senior, client-facing role suited to a high-performing enterprise sales professional who is comfortable operating at C-level. The Enterprise Sales Director will own revenue growth within Tier 1 and Tier 2 financial institutions, with responsibility for developing new strategic accounts as well as expanding existing relationships. You will have full accountability for the sales process, working in tandem with Pre-Sales, Product, and Marketing teams to build compelling value propositions.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and implement a strategic sales plan targeting enterprise banking clients across the UK & EMEA.
  • Build and maintain a high-quality pipeline of opportunities, with an average deal size of £500k–£1.5m ARR.
  • Engage at executive level (CIO, CDO, COO) to position the SaaS platform as a mission-critical solution.
  • Partner with Pre-Sales to deliver workshops, demos, and tailored solution designs.
  • Negotiate multi-year SaaS contracts with complex procurement processes.
  • Report regularly on forecasts, pipeline health, and key wins to senior leadership and board members.
  • Represent the business at industry conferences, roundtables, and FinTech events.
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Marketing to ensure the platform evolves in line with client needs.
Candidate Profile:
  • 8–12 years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, ideally within FinTech, RegTech, or PayTech.
  • Proven track record of exceeding £1m+ annual quotas and closing multi-year SaaS contracts.
  • Strong executive network within major banks, asset managers, and insurers.
  • Comfortable navigating long and complex procurement cycles.
  • Gravitas and presence to represent the business at C-level and industry events.
  • Collaborative mindset, able to partner with technical and commercial colleagues effectively.
  • Additional languages (French/German) highly desirable but not essential.
Why Apply?

This is a rare opportunity to join a hyper-growth SaaS business backed by top-tier investors. You’ll be rewarded with excellent earning potential (including stock options), genuine career progression (opportunity to grow into VP/Regional GM), and the chance to be part of a company that is redefining how financial institutions adopt digital technology.

job.title: Director of Revenue Enablement
job.description:
About the Client: Our client is an enterprise data intelligence SaaS platform that has recently scaled its international footprint across EMEA and North America. They support over 200 commercial reps globally and need a centralized enablement leader to drive productivity.

The Role: The Director of Revenue Enablement will bridge the gap between product strategy and sales execution. You will design, build, and deploy the global onboarding and continuous development programs for Account Executives, SDRs, and Customer Success Managers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build a scalable GTM onboarding curriculum that reduces "time-to-ramp" for new commercial hires by 20%+.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate complex product rollouts into practical, high-impact sales plays and competitive battlecards.
  • Define and audit tool adoption frameworks for the commercial tech stack (Gong, Highspot, Salesforce).
  • Establish data-driven metrics to track the direct correlation between enablement programs and quota attainment.

Candidate Requirements:

  • 6+ years of enablement experience within a B2B SaaS architecture, with at least 2 years in a leadership position.
  • Deep knowledge of modern sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Force Management).
  • Exceptional communication skills, with a track record of gaining buy-in from senior sales stakeholders.

Who We Are: IN2 SaaS Recruitment is a premier, dedicated talent partner specializing exclusively in the global SaaS and technology ecosystem. With deep-rooted networks spanning EMEA and North America, we connect hyper-growth scale-ups and established enterprise software vendors with transformative leadership talent. We pride ourselves on our consultative, data-driven approach, ensuring an elite match for both complex technical structures and fast-paced commercial environments.
